label: Todoist Task
description: A task from a Todoist account, as the Todoist connector reads it through the Sync API: a task whose priority, due date and completion are the core task's, with Todoist's own placing of it beside them.

project_id.description: The Todoist project the task sits in.

section_id.description: The section of that project, where it has one.

parent_id.description: The Todoist task this one is a subtask of.

labels.description: The task's Todoist labels, by name.

child_order.description: Where the task sits among its siblings in Todoist.

comment_count.description: How many comments the task has in Todoist.
